image_description: A top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) resting on a white, textured surface (likely a cloth). The crab displays a broad, oval carapace with reddish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. It has five pairs of legs extending laterally, with the first pair modified into large claws (chelipeds). The eyes are visible on stalks at the anterior margin. The lighting is diffuse, casting soft shadows.
